rv.q: This little fable about loneliness and love, family and friends, makes a rewarding evening filled with warmth, humor and hope.
All the well-cast performers shine, but it's the chemistry between Frawley's Anthony and Ownby's Rosemary that stands out, as they demonstrate just how subtly erotic a long-simmering romance can be.
This is a delightful experience for a theater audience, young and old.
Outside Mullingar really gets inside its characters with sweetness and charm.
